summary: Solmate Infrastructure PLC, an Irish-domiciled digital-asset treasury and staking company listed on Nasdaq (SLMT), furnished a Form 6-K on October 30, 2026, confirming it holds no digital assets on Binance following a reported Binance security incident. The company states its 1.26 million SOL (as of October 29, 2026) sits with qualified custodians Kraken, Anchorage Digital and Bitgo, and that validator infrastructure operates normally. No transaction, price, stake, board recommendation or advisor is disclosed. The filing is a routine operational disclosure regarding counterparty exposure, not a special situation; watch only for fiduciary or solvency implications from the incident.
